title: Mattel Celebrates 25 Years of ‘Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone’ With New Collectible Dolls
summary: The collectible dolls capture the magic of the first film with Harry, Ron and Hermione wearing their signature Hogwarts uniforms.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Twenty-five years ago, the Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone film transported movie audiences to the Wizarding World for the first time. To celebrate the milestone anniversary, Mattel is bringing the magic back with a new collection of collectible fashion dolls inspired by the film’s original Golden Trio.

The collection features movie-inspired fashion dolls of Harry Potter, Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger dressed in their signature Hogwarts uniforms. Designed with screen-inspired details, each doll recreates the trio’s iconic looks from the 2001 film, complete with Gryffindor robes and character-inspired accessories that pay tribute to the movie that launched one of the most beloved cinematic franchises in entertainment history.

The collectible dolls are just one part of the 25th anniversary celebration honoring the film that started the movie series. Fans can also add the new 25 Year Anniversary Edition of the Harry Potter Paperback Full Book Set (Volumes 1-7) to their collections, featuring refreshed anniversary packaging for the complete seven-book series. And for those looking to revisit Harry’s first adventure on screen, Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone is also available on DVD and in a Blu-ray edition that includes bonus content from the film.

HOGWARTS COLLECTIBLE

Mattel Harry Potter Fashion Doll

$16.19

Buy now on amazon

Features a fully posable design for display options or imaginative play.

Bring home a piece of Hogwarts history with Mattel’s Harry Potter Gryffindor Uniform fashion doll. Inspired by the first film, the collectible recreates Harry’s signature wizarding style and stands 10.43 inches tall with a posable design and removable wand accessories.

RON JOINS THE MAGIC

Mattel Ron Weasley Fashion Doll

Complete the Golden Trio with Mattel’s Ron Weasley collectible doll.

Mattel’s Ron Weasley fashion doll brings Harry Potter’s loyal best friend to life with movie-inspired details from the Wizarding World. Dressed in his classic Gryffindor uniform, the collectible includes removable clothing pieces, a wand accessory and a posable design for fans and collectors.

GRYFFINDOR’S BRIGHTEST WITCH

Mattel Hermione Granger Fashion Doll

$19.99

With bendable arms, head and legs, the Hermione doll can be posed in spell-casting stances.

The brightest witch of her age joins Mattel’s collectible lineup with the Hermione Granger fashion doll, inspired by her iconic debut in Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone . Dressed in her signature Gryffindor uniform and complete with a wand accessory and posable design, the doll brings Hermione’s first-year Hogwarts adventures to life.

ORIGINAL COVERS

25 Year Anniversary Edition of Harry Potter Paperback Full Book Set Volumes 1-7

$68 $77.95 13% off

Classic paperback edition of the first seven Harry Potter books with original covers.

For fans ready to revisit the magic, Scholastic’s Harry Potter 25-Year Anniversary Paperback Full Book Set includes all seven novels with newly refreshed covers. Each edition features the iconic Harry Potter logo hand-drawn by original U.S. illustrator Mary GrandPré and detailed gold foil accents that reveal hidden nods to the Wizarding World.

THE COMPLETE HOGWARTS SAGA

Harry Potter: The Complete 8-Film Collection (Blu-ray)

$54.96

Available in Blu-ray for $54.96, DVD for $37.99 and 4K for $69.99.

Experience the complete Harry Potter saga with Harry Potter: The Complete 8-Film Collection on Blu-ray. The eight-disc set includes every film from Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone to Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows — Part 2 , following Harry, Ron and Hermione’s journey from their first year at Hogwarts to the final battle against Lord Voldemort.

GRAPHIC AUDIO

Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone (Full-Cast Edition)

$0.99

Audible’s immersive full-cast edition is now available for $0.99 per month for the first three months.

From the Hogwarts corridors to the Quidditch pitch, Audible’s Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone (Full-Cast Edition) delivers an immersive journey into the Wizarding World. The production features Dolby Atmos sound design, a new musical score and a star-studded cast including Hugh Laurie as Albus Dumbledore and Riz Ahmed as Professor Snape.

No celebration of Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone would be complete without its iconic music . John Williams’ instantly recognizable “Hedwig’s Theme” and the film’s sweeping orchestral score have continued to transport fans back to Hogwarts for 25 years, becoming some of the most memorable compositions in modern film history. The movie’s musical legacy even inspired other artists, including Bruce Springsteen , who revealed during a 2017 BBC Radio 2 interview that he wrote a ballad for Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone that was ultimately not used in the film. Titled “I’ll Stand By You Always,” the song briefly surfaced online years later before being removed, giving fans a rare look at a piece of Harry Potter history that almost became part of the franchise’s soundtrack.

From Mattel’s collectible dolls and anniversary book set to the full-cast audiobook and the unforgettable score that continues to define the Wizarding World, the 25th anniversary of Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone proves the magic of the franchise is still alive decades later.
